'''Toggeus''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was home to the [[TransGalMeg Industries Corporate Starport]], the [[TransGalMeg Industries Conference Center]], and the corporate detention block.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
